reviews.title: Not a True Vision Board
reviews.text: I was looking for an app where I could create a virtual version of a physical vision board, so I could add inspiration photos and texts of my goals. I want to be able to make a collage with overlapping items. This app will let me add as many photos as I want, but they are all straight; I can’t angle them. Also, the text is attached as affirmations to a photo. Affirmations are wonderful, but not something I need for my current goal. I also wanted to save a copy of the vision board to use as my phone background and lock screen, but this app creates a video of the photos and affirmations, not a board.

reviews.title: The Best Vision Board, Affirmations & Guided Meditations in the App Store
reviews.text: I’ve downloaded every vision board in the App Store and this is the best BY FAR.  It has lots of things NONE of the other vision boards have:  1.  When you’re creating your vision board and need a picture, it connect you directly to websites where you can immediately upload the picture.  You can, of course, upload your own images.  2.  You can affirmations to go with your images.  Then when you go to review the your vision board, it all plays — the pictures and a voice reads the affirmations.  3.  There are additional supporting guided mediation as that lead you through a process where you imagine achieving your goal.  4.  You get pop up affirmations.  5.  There are some guided meditations to relax and they are outstanding and extremely effective.  And there are more things, but these are the important pieces.  The main thing is that in one place you have every kind of support to make your vision a reality.  I just got it and will use it for all sorts of tings I want to bring into my life.  I am so happy and grateful that someone had the genius to create something that is really helpful and very effective.  Thank you!

reviews.title: LOVE this app!
reviews.text: I found this app because I have Mind Movies. While I love Mind Movies, you can only make videos on their (ancient) website, and only watch them on their glitchy app. I need an app where I can easily make vision boards on my phone in 10 minutes or less, start to finish. Perfectly Happy IS that app! I have made at least 8 vision boards in the two months I have had this app. One of my vision boards is already becoming a reality! I tell absolutely everyone about this app. Yes, it does cost money. But IT IS WORTH IT! My only complaint is that I can’t share vision boards with anyone outside of the app. With Mind Movies I can download a video to my device and share with anyone. Would love to be able to do that with Perfectly Happy. Other than that, beautiful. Absolutely what I was looking for in a vision board app. Many thanks to the creators of this app 💖

reviews.title: I am motivated to change
reviews.text:
Rating: 5/5 Stars

Review:

I've always been a big believer in the power of visualization and goal setting, so when I stumbled upon this app, I knew I had to give it a try. And let me tell you, it exceeded all my expectations!

First off, the app is incredibly easy to use; everything is intuitive and user-friendly. I love how I can easily upload images, set goals, and organize my vision board to reflect my aspirations.

I enjoy  its motivational features. The daily reminders and affirmations keep me focused and inspired, while the progress tracker helps me stay accountable and celebrate my wins along the way. It's like having a personal cheerleader in my pocket!

What I appreciate most about this app is its versatility. Whether I'm striving for personal growth, career success, or health and wellness goals, it adapts to my needs and empowers me to pursue my dreams with confidence.

In short, if you're looking for a powerful tool to help you turn your dreams into reality, look no further. It's not just an app – it's a game-changer for anyone committed to achieving their goals and living their best life.

reviews.title: Good idea but could use some work
reviews.text:
This is a great idea, but I think it would be better if the developers could give it a little upgrade. The quality & variety of the images could be improved (they look like stock images now), and the emotionless/robotic AI voice reading the affirmations is pretty bad, as well. We can do better than this.

Returning to this review after spending more time with the app & updating to 5 stars. There were a lot of features I missed before writing my first review, for example, I now see that you can turn the AI voice off or change it to different tones/accents. I created 2 vision boards & found a lot of different images &  also like the music you can add to the background. I really like that there are vision board examples & also the fact that there is a separate affirmation feature. The affirmations are very good. I can look at my board & then do a 1 min affirmation session a few times a day for a quick boost. The app really does make it easy for you to stay focused & positive 😊
